BiblicalUsage: Seber is expectation, hope, and the psalms put it in God's hands. Uphold me according unto Thy word, that I may live, and let me not be ashamed of my hope. Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hope is only as good as what it rests on, and these two verses rest it on the God of Jacob.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
